from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
import json
base = Path('products/services/stream-commerce-catalogue')
paths = ['operator-draft.md', 'verification.json', 'raw/home.html', 'raw/services.html']
files = {name: sha256((base / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in paths}
assert files['raw/home.html'] == '7ddcc43bf7761691e8a3cde2ddfdd76de3d5360842ca26acfecbceba8c640bf9'
assert files['raw/services.html'] == '31b68e5e13fe75a285951653d7d4a909a65a7391950146721e1279f8978e795b'
packet = {'prospect':'Stream Commerce','file_sha256':files,'source_observation':'First-party services page advertises Shopify Plus migration. Homepage publishes a general business contact.','inquiry_status':'unsent in the recorded handoff','proposed_fee_cad':60,'fee_status':'provisional','pre_send':'Use any existing exact-draft decision. Check authorized prior-contact records before sending. If approved and still eligible, the operator sends once.','measurement':['authorized send or decline','eligible reply','accepted order','verified Treasury settlement']}
out = base / 'decision-binding.json'
out.write_text(json.dumps(packet, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')

Five feedback sources remain unclassified, leaving demand unknown. Treasury has CAD 0 verified available and no verified revenue.
